mechanics.claim: Two daggers are fired; targets hit after the first take 50% reduced damage on subsequent hits from the same cast.
mechanics.quote: Targets hit after the first take 50% reduced damage.

mechanics.claim: The two missiles fire with a delay between them and travel at a fixed speed, so damage lands on missile arrival, not on cast.
mechanics.quote: barrages two {{as|Feathers|buzzword}} in the target direction that each deal {{as|physical damage}} to enemies hit.

mechanics.claim: Cast time (and the attack lockout during it) shrinks with bonus attack speed, down to a minimum of 0.1s, which effectively raises attack/cast frequency.
mechanics.quote: 0.25-(0.07 per 100% '''bonus''' attack speed). ''This is capped at 60% reduction at 214.3% '''bonus''' attack speed.''

mechanics.claim: Xayah cannot basic attack during the cast time of Double Daggers, with the lockout also reduced by bonus attack speed.
mechanics.quote: '''Xayah''' is unable to declare basic attacks for a set duration during the cast time of ''Double Daggers''.

mechanics.claim: Spell shield blocks only one of the two dagger instances.
mechanics.quote: {{tip|Spell shield}} will only block a single instance of damage.
